# Original scene fixtures

These two unmodified photographs are by **admin / YouSpeed Panoramax**, captured
on 14 October 2026, and licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
Source item and image links, original hashes, capture dates and the relationship
to the existing OCR crops are in [provenance.json](provenance.json). The image
bytes match the existing crop manifest's `source_asset_sha256` values exactly.

These are test resources only. Complete original scenes permit the actual native
detector, plate geometry and OCR paths to be checked without invented surrounding
pixels or annotated primary boxes. Repeated fixture frame identities and clocks
remain controlled test inputs; they do not represent an independently recorded
moving sequence or a field recognition-rate estimate. Source server annotations
remain unverified and are not promoted to executable road rules.
